conflicts.description: The ground-truth Pro script drives reflection object f59b from public lamp state 59 through FlashAR, while no FadeL insert or physical socket is identified; physical population and semantics remain unresolved. Resolution path: a LibPinMAME Single Lamp Test trace against a legal Pro ROM such as xmn_151, reading the name that Pro firmware prints for lamp address 59, together with a photograph of an unrestored X-Men Pro playfield showing whether an insert or bulb socket is fitted where the retained manual's Lamp Locations drawing (PDF page 59, printed 7) places callout 59 and its Lamp Matrix Grid (PDF page 58, printed 6) names it; the retained scan does not mark that pair Pro or Limited Edition, so a Pro-only Stern parts book would settle it as well. Unresolved.

mechanisms.behavior: The working Pro script models four balls at switches 18-21 with output 1 feeding the shooter lane through jam opto 22.
mechanisms.label: Four-ball trough

mechanisms.behavior: Output 2 launches the ball from switch 23.
mechanisms.label: Auto launcher

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 4 holds the ball and output 3 ejects it.
mechanisms.label: Power Scoop lower-left eject

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 55 holds the ball; output 5 kicks it vertically onto the left ramp.
mechanisms.label: Left vertical up-kicker

mechanisms.behavior: The dual up-post lock uses outputs 6/7 and occupancy sensors 53, 38, 39, and 40.
mechanisms.label: Magneto four-ball center lock

mechanisms.behavior: Output 26 sends the orbit shot into the rear of the lock.
mechanisms.label: Magneto orbit diverter

mechanisms.behavior: PWM output 4 controls the Magneto magnet. The Pro has no spinning disc motor.
mechanisms.label: Magneto playfield magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Switch 36 senses the passive wobbling bash toy; the proven Pro table binds output 32 to a nearby playfield magnet with center-grab disabled, so the ball is deflected rather than rigidly centered.
mechanisms.label: Wolverine bash toy and magnet

mechanisms.behavior: Physical outputs 15/16 drive the lower pair and output 12 drives the upper-right flipper; dedicated switch 86 is the staged upper button. The legacy table visually couples the upper flipper to output 16 and comments out callback 12, so recreations must retain the physical 12/86 mapping instead of copying that shortcut.
mechanisms.label: Three-flipper assembly

mechanisms.behavior: The three pop output/switch pairs are 9/30, 10/31, and 11/32.
mechanisms.label: Three pop bumpers

mechanisms.behavior: Left and right slings use output/switch pairs 13/26 and 14/27.
mechanisms.label: Two slingshots

mechanisms.behavior: The seven physical targets are the two Hellfire, two Brotherhood, two Light Lock, and Wolverine bash targets.
mechanisms.label: Seven standup targets

mechanisms.behavior: The Pro has two molded ramps, left/right orbits, and the inner loop; it does not have the Iceman transfer ramp. Lamps 11 and 38 retain Nightcrawler-themed printed feature art but are static inserts, not sensors or moving mechanisms.
mechanisms.label: Two ramps and orbit network

mechanisms.behavior: Output 8 is the optional 16 VAC shaker installation and may be absent from a stock machine.
mechanisms.label: Optional shaker motor
